title: No Easy Way to Stuff!!
text:
No Easy Way to Stuff!!. Had one before... unless you have a clue how gross it is to stuff sausage (raw intestines, stuffed with raw meats, fillers, etc. with one of their clever tools.
Puncture your casing, may have to start over.
Then there's the SMELL (sorry. stench)
Then there's the odor
Then there's permeation of blood and raw meat that can ruin some surfaces (wood)
Then there's the odor
